commits.summary: Renamed the 17 ScreenData-interpreter wrappers SeMenu_NameEditor_* -> SeGfx_* (DrawStaticList, DrawBoundList, DrawBoundRecord, StaticOpNN_*, BoundOpNN) in v10/v9/v7 and added a header giving the record format and the two interpreters. Verified by se_gfx_wrappers_probe.py: 51/51 name-to-target pairs agree with the handler tables read from each ROM.

Typed the sound editor's 19,617-byte screen-data block (SeScreenData..SeScreenData_End) from its readers in all three versions. It is now record macros (sd_*/sdb_*), .long pointer tables, .ascii string cells, .short box tables and column-major 1-bpp bitmaps. This retired 17,979 B of v7 romslices and 520 v10 data-as-code markers. Model: 248 record lists, every one parsing exactly to the end its code states.

Code operands that pointed into the block (numeric values or positional aliases of the old wrong base names) now use the block's new labels: v10 341, v9 341, v7 144 operands. Removed 14 dead TuningSys_Param_* .set aliases per file; renamed the unreferenced picture to SeBitmap_Picture40x40.

se_reframe_code.py re-framed 652 (v10) / 654 (v9) mis-decoded code windows, for example `.byte 0x8f / push xsp / nop` -> `cp (xsp+2), 0`. A window is accepted only if unidasm and the tree's backend agree on every boundary and it is flanked by code. Then the branch symboliser rewrote 620 (v10) / 622 (v9) operands.

v7 sound_editor_ui.s + semenu_routines.s: 70 .byte/romslice runs (7,939 B) decoded in lock-step, each backed by a v10 witness (at least 90% of comparable instructions start a v10 instruction line; the 4,382 B run scored 1,342/1,379). Also ran v10/v9 re-frame round 2 (short .ascii seeds); symboliser v7 376 operands.

Typed SeEnvCurve_BitmapTable (7 pointers to the 40x40 envelope-curve bitmaps, with its reader cited) in v10/v9/v7. Entry 0 was misframed as instructions in v10/v9 and was the tail of a romslice in v7 (split by v7_curve_table_fix.py, witness 121/123). Removed the unreferenced label SeMenu_WaveformSelect_Init, which named a routine.

Added reader/evidence header lines above every C screen descriptor inside SeScreenData (v10 23, v9 8, v7 1) and headers for the two 48-entry screen-handler tables (SeMenu_ShowPopupDialog_Draw / SeMenu_ShowConfirmDialog_Data). Re-frame round 3: 2 windows each in v10/v9.

Decoded v7 sndparam_routines.s over 0xFCCE9F-0xFCED54 (7,861 B, mostly .byte rows) in lock-step. Against a map of all v10 files, 2,768 of 2,776 comparable instructions line up. 66 misplaced labels that fall inside instructions are kept at their exact addresses as `.set Name, . + k`, with a file-header warning. Symboliser: 298 operands.
v7 semenu_routines.s: the 801 B romslice at the end of the file is code (witness 245/245) plus two 12 B runs; a run may now end at the file's last byte. Symboliser: 18 operands.

Decoded the push/pop no-op routine (`.ascii "89:;<=>^]\\[ZYX"`) in v10/v9/v7. Committed the before/after census summary (census_before_after_2026-09-25.txt); seui_census_summary.py now also counts numeric branches.

gate: `make gate` passed (9 KN5000 images IDENTICAL) in the worktree before every one of the 10 commits; the last run was on the final tree (09123f18). The comment gate (`assert_comments_preserved.py`, with `--rename-map` for the wrapper rename) passed on every edited file. I also showed the gate can fail on my work: changing one number in one rendered record (`sd_quad 0x09, 5, 30, 43, 47` -> `48`) made `make gate` report `kn5000_v10_program 1 BYTES DIFFER` (the byte is at 0xF1144A). The log is committed as scripts/lanes/seui/gate_perturbed_2026-09-25.log, and the file was restored before committing. Every symboliser run also passed its own `--verify` (re-mirrored tree == dump).
not_done:
1. ToneGen_ParamTable (v7 0xE0E407) was NOT renamed. It is defined in v7/maincpu/kn5000_v7_program.s, with aliases in shared/positional_labels.s, and both files belong to lane sys; my files only reference it.
2. 314 B inside SeScreenData have no reader. Forms searched: LE32/LE24/LE16 of each address, ld xiy/xix/xiz immediates, and the loop bounds of the neighbouring tables. They are:
- a 40x40 column-major picture, SeBitmap_Picture40x40 (its address appears only as a list END)
- `NORM 1/2...`, a duplicate of a referenced string table
- two identical 30-byte groups of op-05 records and one 20-byte group of op-1B records, all inside C descriptors
- the two bytes "+-"
All carry an admission in the source.
3. Backend decode gaps leave small `.byte` islands: register shift-by-A forms (`cb fe` = sll A,C; `d9 fd` = sra A,BC) and register-indexed forms (`c3 07 e0 e4 21` = ld A,(XWA+BC)). These account for most of the 44 remaining markers in v10/v9 and 24 in v10 sndparam_routines.s.
4. v7 sndparam_routines.s: 66 labels sit inside instructions of the verified framing. They are kept as `.set` so the byte-exact references `.long SndParam_X + N` in ui_widgets/widget_dispatch.s still resolve. Moving them to the same-named v10 label by content was tried and rejected, because two labels can share their first 10 bytes and land on one address. The last 16 B of the file (`.byte 0xf1,0x20,0x04` plus the 13 B romslice heapallocok) straddle the end of the file. The 6 B romslice OrPartConfig_Data_head in semenu is also untouched.
5. v7: 29 small runs in sound_editor_ui.s and 6 in semenu_routines.s were refused because the witness disagrees, so v7 still has 40 markers and 163 numeric branches.
6. v10 still uses the 24 C descriptors while v9 and v7 now spell the same screens with the sd_* macros. I did not unify them. The C files misread op 06: their `.addr` field is really a y*40+x/8 cell position. This is documented in the README; the .c files were not edited.
7. Naming: I did not rename the many structural/data-shaped names. This includes the one mega-routine SeMenu_CopyWriteUpdate_* that is really many routines, and the handler-table entries SeMenu_DataBlock_01..14, SeMenu_FxEdit_DataBlock*, SeMenu_FilterEdit_DataBlock*, Data_UnknownBlock, which are code. SeMenu_ShowPopupDialog / ShowConfirmDialog kept their names; only headers were added.
8. I could not write notes/FINDINGS-seui-*.md: the harness refuses report-style .md files from this agent. The prose is in scripts/lanes/seui/README.md and in source headers instead.
